propositions: SKILL.md lacks a Step 0 that searches the tracker for duplicate reports and establishes the reported-against version before Phase 1

The reported-against version cannot be inferred from a rebar-version field (does not exist in ticket schema); it must be extracted from report text or computed by converting ticket created_at nanoseconds to unix seconds and finding the floor commit via git rev-list --before
The tracker search for duplicates must include closed tickets (759 of 764 bug tickets are closed), not only open tickets, to avoid blind spots

Step 0 must be inserted before Phase 1 in SKILL.md and must include three actions: tracker sweep, reported-against floor derivation with explicit nanosecond-to-seconds conversion, and worktree currency check
The Step-0 duplicates link is an own-tracker writeback that must be added to the approval-gate carve-out list (lines 121-127) to pre-approve it without user intervention
